data.long_meaning: Erisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Eesha’, which means 'Goddess of Love and Fertility'. In Hindu mythology, the Goddess Eesha, also known as Parvati, is the consort of Lord Shiva. She is often depicted as the embodiment of love, fertility, and motherhood.
